claim: Casadonna is a 16th-century former monastery in Parco Nazionale d'Abruzzo with 10 guest rooms, integrated with Ristorante Reale on a 6-hectare estate with vineyards, art by Spalletti and Kosuth.
quote: a 16th century former monastery in Parco Nazionale d'Abruzzo, brought back to life after a courageous restoration focused on maintaining its historical character

claim: Reale's address is Piana Santa Liberata, 67031 Castel di Sangro (AQ).
quote: Piana Santa Liberata – 67031, Castel di Sangro (AQ)

claim: Reale holds three Michelin stars.
quote: MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

claim: Reale and Casadonna close for annual holidays 16 March–9 June 2026; reopen 10 June for dinner. Service Wed dinner only; Thu–Sun lunch + dinner.
quote: Reale Restaurant and Casadonna will close for annual holidays from March 16 through June 9, 2026, with reopening scheduled for June 10 for dinner service

claim: Casadonna Reale rated 4.6/5 over 184 reviews, ranked #1 of 4 guest houses in Castel di Sangro; restaurant is a 1-minute walk from the rooms.
quote: ranked #1 of 4 guest houses in Castel di Sangro... 1 min walk to the renowned restaurant

claim: Casadonna sits at Contrada Santa Liberata, ~0.6 miles (≈1 km) from the centre of Castel di Sangro.
quote: Casadonna Reale is located at Contrada Santa Liberata, 0.6 miles from the center of Castel di Sangro

claim: Il Lavatoio Dimora Storica has 13 rooms in a restored 18th-century communal washhouse, 200 m from Castel di Sangro's main square and cathedral; nightly rates typically $94–$144.
quote: the property houses an ancient building renovated... preserves an original 18th-century communal washhouse... 13 non-smoking rooms... just 200 meters from the main square and cathedral

claim: Hotel Il Tiglio is an adults-only family-run hotel in an early-19th-century building decorated with travertine, copper and wrought iron; 10 rooms; guest rating 9.4; from ~$116/night.
quote: warm, welcoming early 19th-century re-designed building, decorated with local materials including travertine, copper and wrought iron

claim: B&B Il Postale occupies a building on Piazza Plebiscito in Castel di Sangro that historically housed the old post office; renovated and opened as a B&B in 2006.
quote: The building, located in Piazza Plebiscite in Castel di Sangro's main square, housed the old post office long ago. It was renovated and opened as a B&B in 2006.

claim: B&B Il Postale rated 8.6/10 on Booking; central location with homemade breakfast featuring local products.
quote: Booking.com guests have rated it 8.6 out of 10

claim: Agriturismo Il Vecchio Pollaio is a working family-run agriturismo with 9 en-suite rooms, garden, outdoor pool, fewer than 20 km from the Abruzzo National Park and under 10 km from Roccaraso ski resorts.
quote: 9 rooms with en-suite bathrooms, a garden, outdoor swimming pool with bar kiosk, and parking

claim: Vecchio Pollaio rated 9.5/10 on Booking; 2.2 km from Castel di Sangro centre (2-minute drive); free bikes and quiet rural setting.
quote: Agriturismo Il Vecchio Pollaio is 2.2 km away from Castel di Sangro city centre... rated 9.5 by recent guests on Booking.com

claim: Hotel Le Torri occupies Palazzo Grilli, the historic dimora of the noble Grilli family of Pescocostanzo, at Via del Vallone 4.
quote: la dimora storica della famiglia Grilli... un ambiente unico nel suo genere, dove arte, tradizione, storia e fascino ambientale convivono in armonia

claim: Hotel Le Torri is a 4-star with 22 rooms in the historic centre of Pescocostanzo; guest rating 8.1; from ~€185/night.
quote: 4-star hotel located in Pescocostanzo... 22 rooms... rated 8.1 by recent guests

claim: Pescocostanzo is listed as one of I Borghi più Belli d'Italia (Italy's Most Beautiful Villages).
quote: Pescocostanzo – I Borghi più Belli d'Italia

claim: Garnì B&B La Rua is a family-run B&B in central Pescocostanzo, run by hosts Luigi, Giuseppe and Elisa.
quote: Garnì B&B La Rua Pescocostanzo

claim: La Rua reviews consistently praise the family hosts, central historic location, and breakfast with freshly baked pastries and goat-milk ricotta.
